title: Malicious document to ransomware
summary: A user opens invoice_8841.docm. Word spawns an encoded PowerShell and rundll32, a dropped svch0st.exe rewrites a finance share and touches a canary file.
provenance: Telemetry from 03-edr-canary-process-tree tests/fixtures/maldoc_ransomware_chain.ndjson (kernel ETW records), mapped to OCSF. The five EDR alerts are transcribed from the documented output of 03's Invoke-SafeSimulation.ps1, in 03's own alert format. The canary alert was sent to 02's real SoarService state machine.
simulated_parts: 03 alerts transcribed from Invoke-SafeSimulation.ps1 output (run it on Windows to regenerate)
Analyst approval click in 02 (95 s after the incident opened)
Isolation ran 02's mock_isolate.py in dry-run mode

stages.name: Encoded PowerShell from Word
stages.description: cmd.exe and powershell -enc launched under Word.

stages.name: rundll32 proxy execution
stages.description: Word starts rundll32 against a DLL in C:\Users\Public.

stages.name: Binary masquerading as svchost
stages.description: svch0st.exe starts from C:\Users\Public. 03 has no rule for this; 08 adds one.

stages.name: Mass file encryption
stages.description: svch0st.exe rewrites 30 files on the finance share.

title: SSH brute force to persistence
summary: An internet host guesses the admin password on web01, logs in, reads /etc/shadow with sudo and creates a backdoor account. Three hours later a second source sprays common accounts.
provenance: 01-realtime-ai-siem tests/fixtures/auth.log replayed through 01's real pipeline (offline summariser), mapped to OCSF. The final alert chain was sent to 02's real SoarService state machine.
simulated_parts: Analyst approval click in 02 (approver analyst.dana, 4 min 10 s after the incident opened)
Isolation ran 02's mock_isolate.py in dry-run mode

stages.name: Login with stolen password
stages.description: The same source logs in successfully as admin.

stages.name: Password hashes read from /etc/shadow
stages.description: The sudo command line is cat /etc/shadow. 01 has no rule for this; 08 adds one.

stages.name: Backdoor account created
stages.description: useradd creates svc-backup with a login shell.

stages.name: Password spray
stages.description: 198.51.100.23 tries one password against many accounts.
